description: Election Commission - Declare that R. Rajendren as a member of the Manthai West P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Manthai West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content is specifically about an electoral process at the local government level, involving a resignation and the subsequent nomination of a new member by a recognized political party, as declared by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
